info.name: LeCoders poll-service
info.description:
AI-generated (Cursor Agent, Claude Opus 5); reviewed by Aliasgar Sakarwala.

API tests for the LeCoders poll-service. One folder per endpoint, each covering the success path and every misuse case documented in docs/API.md.

Run top to bottom against a freshly started server (`mvn spring-boot:run`): the create-poll folder stores every poll_id it needs in collection variables, and later folders depend on those values and on the ballots cast earlier, so requests must not be reordered or run individually.

Use the postman/local.postman_environment.json environment, or set baseUrl, apiKey and otherApiKey yourself. apiKey and otherApiKey must both appear in the poll.api-keys list in src/main/resources/application.properties.
